relevance.rationale: Computes non-abelian Ad-twisted Reidemeister torsion of fibered knots directly from fiber monodromy, with explicit evaluations on torus knots T(2,q) and the figure-eight knot 4_1.

keyResults.statement: Expresses mu-regular non-abelian Reidemeister torsion of a fibered knot in S^3 via the twisted monodromy determinant on the fiber surface group.
keyResults.useForFolio: Cross-checks 4_1 and torus-knot non-abelian torsion from monodromy; claim boundary excludes non-fibered 5_2 (covered instead by dubois2007).
